# Bharat eFiling

> Bharat eFiling (bharatefiling.com) is an Indian online platform for CA-assisted income-tax return filing, GST registration and returns, business registration, trademark and compliance services for individuals, startups and MSMEs.

Pages are reviewed by Chartered Accountants and updated for the CGST Act, 2017, the CGST Rules, 2017 and the Income-tax Act, 2025 (in force from 1 April 2026).

## GST services
- [GST Registration](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-registration/): eligibility, turnover limits, Rule 14A 3-day registration, documents, process, fees, penalties and FAQs
- [GST LUT Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-lut-filing/): Letter of Undertaking in Form GST RFD-11, eligibility, validity, Rule 96A export deadlines, documents, process, refunds and FAQs
- [GST Return Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-return-filing/): GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9 filing
- [GST Registration Amendment](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-registration-amendment/): core vs non-core fields, Form REG-14, 15-day time limit, documents, when a new GSTIN is needed and FAQs
- [GST Revocation](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-revocation/): revocation of cancelled GST registration in Form REG-21, 90-day limit and 180-day extension, pending returns, REG-23/REG-24, options after the deadline and FAQs
- [GSTR-10 Final Return Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/gstr-10-filing/): final return after GST cancellation, 3-month due date, ₹200/day late fee up to ₹10,000, closing stock reversal under Section 29(5), GSTR-3A notices and FAQs
- [GST Annual Return Filing (GSTR-9)](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-annual-return-filing/): GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C applicability by turnover, FY 2025-26 due date, late fee, missed-ITC deadline, tables, documents and FAQs
- [GST Notice Reply](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-notice-reply/): types of GST notices (ASMT-10, DRC-01, DRC-01B/01C, GSTR-3A, REG-17), reply forms and deadlines, Section 74A penalty relief, appeals and FAQs
- [GST LUT Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/gst-lut-filing/): export without paying IGST

## Income tax
- [ITR Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/income-tax-return-filing/)
- [Income Tax e-Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/income-tax-e-filing/): how to e-file an ITR for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27), who must file, which ITR form, due dates, belated, revised and updated returns, e-verification, refunds and FAQs
- [Business ITR Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/business-itr-filing/): ITR-3, ITR-4, ITR-5 and ITR-6 for proprietors, firms, LLPs and companies; presumptive taxation (44AD, 44ADA, 44AE), tax audit, partner remuneration and Section 194T TDS, due dates for FY 2025-26 and FAQs
- [Partnership Firm & LLP ITR Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/partnership-llp-itr-filing/): ITR-5 for partnership firms and LLPs, 30% tax rate, partner remuneration under Section 40(b), Section 194T TDS, tax and LLP audits, LLP Form 8 and Form 11, due dates for FY 2025-26 and FAQs
- [Company ITR Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/company-itr-filing/): ITR-6 for companies, Section 115BAA vs normal tax and MAT, Form 10-IC, losses and Section 79, Section 80-IAC startups, ROC filings AOC-4 and MGT-7, due dates for FY 2025-26 and FAQs
- [Trust & NGO Tax Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/trust-ngo-itr-filing/): ITR-7 for trusts, societies and Section 8 companies; 85% application, Form 10 and 9A, Form 10B/10BB audit, corpus and anonymous donations, 80G Form 10BD/10BE, 12AB renewal, FCRA FC-4, due dates for FY 2025-26 and FAQs
- [TAN Registration](https://bharatefiling.com/tan-registration/): applying for TAN in Form 49B, who needs a TAN and the PAN-based exceptions (26QB, 26QC, 26QD), TDS deposit and quarterly return dates, penalties and FAQs
- [TDS Return Filing](https://bharatefiling.com/tds-return-filing/): quarterly TDS and TCS returns (24Q, 26Q, 27Q, 27EQ), due dates, Form 16 and 16A, Section 234E late fee and 271H penalty, TRACES defaults and corrections, TDS rates and thresholds from April 2025, and FAQs
- [Income Tax Notice Reply](https://bharatefiling.com/income-tax-notice/): what income tax notices under Sections 139(9), 143(1)(a), 143(2), 142(1), 148A, 156, 245 and 270A mean, reply deadlines, DIN verification, demand interest, penalties, rectification and appeals, and FAQs
- [Income-tax Act, 2025 changes](https://bharatefiling.com/learn/income-tax-act-2025-changes/)
